scripts.host: pnpm run make && pnpm publish --access public
scripts.install:all: pnpm install && (cd deck/deck && pnpm install) && (cd deck/mill && pnpm install) && (cd deck/base && pnpm install) && (cd deck/flow && pnpm install --ignore-workspace)
scripts.make:load: pnpm run make:port && pnpm exec tsx task/make-load.ts
scripts.make:line: pnpm run make:port && pnpm exec esbuild deck/call/code/line.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=host/line.js --banner:js='#!/usr/bin/env node' && pnpm exec esbuild deck/call/code/hook-dispatch.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=host/dock.mjs && pnpm exec esbuild deck/call/code/need-run.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=host/need.mjs && pnpm exec esbuild deck/call/code/need-hand.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=host/need-hand.mjs
